---
title: "About"
---

I grew up in Bangladesh and studied economics at Noakhali Science & Technology University,
where I finished both my bachelor's and master's degrees before teaching for two years at
National Model College.

I then spent three years at Bangladesh Honda Private Limited in corporate affairs and safety,
first as an Executive and later as a Senior Executive. That period taught me a great deal about
how firms actually make decisions under regulatory and operational constraints — something I
still think about when I read finance papers.

In 2023 I moved to Texas for an M.S. in Economics at the University of North Texas, concentrating
in econometrics and quantitative methods, and I am now in the finance PhD program at Old Dominion
University in Norfolk, Virginia.
